verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a demo/sandbox environment with auto-generated demo companies and separate API credentials for testing (gusto-docs-13, gusto-docs-51), which lets developers test integrations without touching production data. However, there's no explicit documentation of an AI-native testing workflow or agentic sandbox tied to the MCP server itself, and no independent confirmation of sandbox fidelity or isolation guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/production data-isolation guarantees, AI-agent-specific sandbox testing guidance, and independent verification of the demo environment's parity with production.
